tools.name: everlist_contract
tools.description: Discovery: the EverList hub manifest - payment mode, fee policy, identity requirements, verticals, and endpoint map. Call this first.

tools.name: everlist_verticals
tools.description: Vertical schema registry: required/optional fields, categories, and booking shape per vertical (events, food, services, jobs, classes, p2p).

tools.name: everlist_search
tools.description: Search public listings. q = free text; optional vertical, category, tags (comma-separated), from/to (YYYY-MM-DD), min_price/max_price (numbers), sort.

tools.name: everlist_listing
tools.description: One listing, full record: title, date, place, price, escrow terms, capacity, rating.

tools.name: everlist_book
tools.description: Book (or apply+pay for jobs) a listing into escrow. Requires a hub token in the X-Hub-Token header on the MCP request (header-only auth; obtain via the hub auth contract: POST /accounts/signup + /accounts/login, keypair stays client-side). human_verified must be true (interim credential; production

tools.name: everlist_booking
tools.description: Booking status for the token holder: escrow state, amount, confirmation code.
